collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 4-9 and an adult)

collection.description: A child worries a new baby in the hut will change everything: answer right away, or ask what the worry is.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A new baby is coming to (subject)'s hut soon. Everybody is very excited. (subject) is very quiet. Today (subject.he/she) asks (friend), "Will everyone still like me when the baby's here?"

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Of course they will," says (friend). "Nothing changes that." (subject) looks at (friend.him/her), unconvinced. "But babies are very small and everyone likes small things." (friend) laughs and tells (subject.him/her) all the ways (subject.he/she) is still needed: for jokes, for help, for knowing where the best shells are. (subject) is a bit reassured. Only a bit. That's alright.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks. (subject) explains, in pieces: babies cry, and grown-ups get tired, and nobody will have time to play. (friend) doesn't pretend none of that will happen. "Some of it might," (friend.he/she) says. "But there'll always be someone who has time for you. Me, for a start." (subject) holds (friend.him/her) to that. Often.
